what: B holds, beside Bo's signed case (header H0): a note of Bo's that is not the shape, signed alone under Hm, whose _r_batch names H0; a header Hi of Bo's over a note that is not the shape and a note B no longer holds, so Hi is authentic and not complete; and a case of Bo's naming a header nobody holds. Merging B into A refuses Hm as ROW_MALFORMED and does not report its note again under H0; keeps Hi, which is not complete, and reports its note ROW_MALFORMED under Hi, the batch it names; and reports the last case BATCH_DIGEST_MISMATCH under the id it names, since the sibling held no header there to refuse.
